title: Cereblnk runtime evidence
description: One host, one run, one Cereblnk commit. This file answers: which host, at which version, running which commit of this repository, reached which stage, with what result, and where the evidence is. A PASS without a host version is weak evidence, because host behaviour changes independently of anything here — so host_version is required and may be the string 'unknown' only when the host would not report one.

schema_version.description: Bumped when the shape changes, so an old artifact stays readable instead of being silently misread.

host_version.description: As the host reports it. 'unknown' is allowed and is itself a finding.

runner.description: Operating system and image of the machine that observed this.

inference_provider.description: The service that answered the host, which is not the host itself. Claude Code speaks its protocol to whatever base URL it is given, so a run backed by a gateway establishes nothing about direct provider authentication. Absent when no authenticated stage ran.

configured_model.description: The model this run asked the provider for, as configured rather than as routed. A router may serve a different model per request, so this records the request and never guesses the answer.

workflow_sha.description: Commit of the workflow that produced this, so a change in the measuring instrument is distinguishable from a change in what it measured.

stages.description: Keyed by stage name. A stage the host cannot reach is recorded UNSUPPORTED rather than omitted: a missing stage reads as untested, and untested is not unsupported.

status.description: BLOCKED never becomes FAIL: a missing credential is not a defect in this repository. UNMEASURED never becomes PASS.

capabilities.description: Capability ids from policies/capabilities.yaml. This field cites the catalogue; it never extends it.

evidence.description: Paths inside the artifact, or short observations. Never credentials, never a whole host config directory.

reason.description: Required reading for BLOCKED and UNSUPPORTED, where the status alone does not say why.
